author: Sri Vanaja Geetha Kola
content:
Has anyone tried mixing vermicompost with cow dung slurry? Did you notice better moisture retention?  Would love to hear your experiences! 🌿 Let’s help each other grow better crops! 🙌
Hi everyone! 😊
I wanted to share a simple but effective farming tip that many farmers in our region are using successfully.

🌱 Tip: Use Vermicompost to Improve Soil Health

Vermicompost (earthworm compost) increases soil fertility, improves soil structure, and retains moisture for a longer time. Even applying 1–2 kg per plant or 1–2 tons per acre makes a big difference in crop growth.

⭐ Why I Recommend It

Increases yield by 10–20%

Reduces need for chemical fertilizers

Keeps soil healthy and soft

Very useful for vegetables & fruit crops

author: Pavan Salagrama
content:
1. Biochar-Enriched Soil
Instead of just compost, try adding biochar (charcoal made from plant waste) to your soil.
It improves soil fertility, retains water, and even reduces pests naturally.
Most farmers focus on chemical fertilizers, so this is relatively rare.
2. Agroforestry with Medicinal Plants
Plant fast-growing trees with undergrowth of herbs like Tulsi, Ashwagandha, or Aloe Vera.
Provides extra income and helps with soil health.
